offerings.name: Search — Free Plan
offerings.pricing: $0/month；1,000 credits / month；500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.price_basis: Free Plan；按每次搜索最多10个结果、2 credits/次折算
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认含Highlights；1–10个结果计2 credits，11–20个计4 credits。

offerings.name: Search — Hobby
offerings.pricing: $16/month billed annually；5,000 credits/month；2,500 searches；1,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Hobby年付月均价；全部5,000 credits用于每次最多10个结果的搜索
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 月付为$19/month；PAYG为$5/1,000 credits，相当于500次最多10结果搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Standard
offerings.pricing: $83/month billed annually；100,000 credits/month；50,000 searches；2,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Standard年付月均价；全部100,000 credits用于每次最多10个结果的搜索
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/2,000 credits，相当于1,000次最多10结果搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Growth
offerings.pricing: $333/month billed annually；500,000 credits/month；250,000 searches；2,500 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Growth年付月均价；全部500,000 credits用于每次最多10个结果的搜索
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/2,500 credits，相当于1,250次最多10结果搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Scale
offerings.pricing: $599/monthly, billed yearly；1,000,000 credits/month；500,000 searches；5,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Scale年付月均价；全部1,000,000 credits用于每次最多10个结果的搜索
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/5,000 credits，相当于2,500次最多10结果搜索。

offerings.name: Search — End-to-End ZDR
offerings.price_basis: Enterprise ZDR search；企业价格为Custom，无法换算美元千次价
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；Firecrawl及上游搜索提供商均不存储查询或结果数据
offerings.note: 通过enterprise:["zdr"]启用；如启用抓取，结果页面另计标准抓取费用。

offerings.name: Search — Anonymized ZDR
offerings.price_basis: Enterprise anonymized ZDR；企业价格为Custom，无法换算美元千次价
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；Firecrawl侧零数据保留，上游可能缓存完全匿名化的查询
offerings.note: 通过enterprise:["anon"]启用；如启用抓取，结果页面另计标准抓取费用。
